messages:
Sam K: FYI I opened a tiny Terraform + Helm change to standardize the ExternalSecret -> k8s secret TTL annotation. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/abcd123

Sam K: TL;DR: move from `redwood/ttl` and `redwood/secret-ttl-old` variants to a single `redwood/secret-ttl` key so our rotation controller picks it up reliably. Plan: canary in staging ns `es-staging`, then rollout to prod.

Maria L: quick q — does this affect the Vault path mapping? we map secrets via `vault/data/team/...` currently. Need to ensure no path change.

Sam K: No path change. This is purely an annotation rename on the k8s Secret created by ExternalSecrets. Vault roles/paths unchanged.

Alex P: I ran the change in sandbox and rotation-controller v1.3 picks up the `redwood/secret-ttl` key fine. Suggest adding a one-off k8s Job to migrate old annotations -> new to avoid losing TTLs on existing secrets. I can add that manifest to the PR.

Noah R: good call. Also make sure the Helm template omits the annotation if TTL is nil, otherwise it will leave a blank annotation which might confuse the controller.

Sam K: Yep, I'll add a `{{- if .Values.secretTTL }}` guard to the chart.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for PR abcd123 — job: terratest, helm-lint, tf-plan. Status: pending. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam K: Posting TF plan excerpt below (sanitized):
```
  # module.external_secrets.kubernetes_manifest.es_bridge will be updated in-place
  ~ resource "kubernetes_manifest" "es_bridge" {
      ~ manifest = jsonencode({
          ~ metadata = {
              ~ annotations = {
                  - "redwood/ttl" = "30d" -> null,
                  + "redwood/secret-ttl" = "30d"
                }
            }
        })
    }
```

Maria L: That plan looks safe. No `serviceAccount` or role changes. Please ensure the migration Job has a short TTL and is namespaced to `infra-migrations`.

Alex P: I'll author the Job. Idea: run a simple `kubectl patch secret` loop that copies `redwood/ttl` -> `redwood/secret-ttl` for secrets in `es-*` namespaces. I can include a dry-run flag.

Noah R: Ping me after the terraform plan runs. I'll approve if plan contains only annotation updates.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline update for PR abcd123 — tf-plan: success, diff: 1 resource updated (annotation rename). helm-lint: success.

Noah R: Approved. I reviewed the plan output, no IAM or SA diffs. :thumbsup:

Maria L: I'll kick off the canary deploy tomorrow morning and monitor secret-rotation events in the ops dashboard (dashboards/secret-rotation). Will report back after ~2 hours.

Sam K: Thank you all. Action items: Sam - add helm guard + commit patch, Alex - add migration Job (dry-run first), Maria - canary + monitor, Noah - TF approve (done). I'll merge after canary OK.

Alex P: putting migration Job in the PR now, includes a `--dry-run` switch and `ttl=1h` for testing.

Maria L: noted, will watch tomorrow. If anything weird appears we revert and run manual migration. :eyes:

Sam K: Merging blocked until canary passes. Will update thread when merged.

deploy-bot: PR abcd123 merged by Sam K — merge commit ef12ab. Canary deploy triggered to `es-staging`.

Maria L: Canary went green after 45m. rotation events look normal. Approving prod rollout.

Sam K: Merged to prod and ran migration Job with `--apply`. No errors. Closing out. Thanks! :tada:
